address: 25 Dongsi 11th Alley, Dongcheng, Beijing, China Mainland
bio: You'll find this chic and charmingly run sanctuary in an award-winning remodelled courtyard house amid a bustling neighbourhood. The architecture effortlessly blends history with modernism, encompassing motifs from the north and south. Its food is equally striking. To realise her vision, the young chef uses local ingredients for an original dining experience. The wine list offers interesting Chinese choices by the glass, while by-the-bottle options from around the world abound....
